title: A team clone deploys from the public copy: busy-host ceiling at setup, fetch-only upstream, local fixes and backlog provenance
goal: kb-setup asks the operator for the clone's test ceiling profile, usual or busy, where busy multiplies each platform's max_seconds by 15 in that clone only; an agent session cannot write the ceiling file or a decision row directly; the ceiling refusal names the route an operator in an IDE integrated terminal takes; a clone names the public GitHub copy as a fetch-only upstream remote that every push to it refuses; kbgit.py upstream brings the upstream main into the clone's integration main by a written policy that lists each local commit changing an upstream-owned path; every backlog item records its provenance so items arriving from upstream are told apart from items the clone filed; kb_mcp.py registers the kb servers for a workspace directory above the clone with no hand-written .mcp.json

gates.question: Approve this sprint's goal and committed items?
